selection_method: First64Q1/48Q2-only/48Q3-only in retained batch14 queue with unchanged original design/administration/function scores and deterministic tie rules; no new query or result-direction ranking.
original_completeness_limit: Nonempty or complete saved text does not prove complete original abstract; order50 explicitly truncates. Additional source gaps discovered during reading remain preserved.
JSONL_parser_note: Use file iteration or split on ASCII newline only. Valid JSON strings contain Unicode line/paragraph separators; str.splitlines incorrectly breaks them. Frozen bytes must remain unchanged.
limits: Selection verification authenticates deterministic ordering and source identity, not eligibility, scientific reading, unique trials/drugs, efficacy or worldwide completeness. All scientific flags/fixed/notice identities require actual root review before eventual acceptance.
